authoring.note: Both highway lanes onto the fortress island pass underneath it, through a concrete throat wide enough for two vehicles abreast and no more. Traffic slows to walking pace inside, which is the point: the ceiling is firing slits, and a barrier drops at either end independently. Drivers know the drill — window down, pass held up, engine off if asked. At shift change the queue runs back a quarter mile, and the second lane is shut far more often than anyone has ever explained.
